carnival.line: Take my baby to the carnival
stanza: Tonight I'm gonna take that ride
Across the river to the Jersey side
Take my baby to the carnival
And I'll take her on all the rides
In the darkest time of year
Why is it so bright down here?
It ain't right and it ain't natural

carnival.line: In the car behind the carnival
stanza: In the car behind the carnival
My hand between your knees, you turned from me
And said, "The trapeze act was wonderful
But never meant to last", the clown that passed
Saw me just come up with anger
When it filled with circus dogs, the parking lot
